newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha strengthens, but buyers stay choosy.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha strengthens, but buyers stay choosy.

text.p: European naphtha prices continued to strengthen but buying interest, though good, remained restricted to picking off small top-up parcels, traders said.
Traders continued to report good buying interest from petrochemical end-users, who continued to deny their interest was anything but relaxed.
Several small Russian cargoes were seen available with bids valued around MOM and offers around high cif plus.
Prompt full cargo offers remained scarce, but a 60 kt Algerian cargo was talked at benchmark cif high quotes +$2/+3 a tonne with a major petrochemical company on the bid.
